conviction_note: The one hard non-wire fact is a step-change in the density of Form 144 sale notices and Form 4s in the four weeks before the print, concentrated on the run to $34.53; that is a weak negative on a name the corpus says options priced for ~14%, so I take about a tenth of that magnitude and no more.

findings.finding: Braze affiliates filed eleven separate Form 144 sale notices across nine distinct dates in August 2026 (08/07, 08/10, 08/11, 08/13, 08/19 x2, 08/24 x2, 08/26, 08/27 x2) plus thirteen Form 4s on six dates (08/11, 08/12, 08/14, 08/19 x5, 08/21 x2, 08/26 x2, 08/28), against a 400-day baseline of one to four Form 144s per month arriving alongside a single-date vest batch of Form 4s (7 on 2026-02-02, 6 on 2026-02-20, 7 on 2026-03-20, 7 on 2026-05-19, 6 on 2025-11-20); four of the notices land on 08/24-08/27 as the stock printed its high close of $34.53.
findings.corpus_ref: filings.json, CIK 0001676238: Form 144 entries filing_date 2026-08-07 through 2026-08-27 and Form 4 entries 2026-08-11 through 2026-08-28, compared against the same file's 2025-09 to 2026-07 history
findings.why_not_priced: The news channel returned zero items for BRZE across all eleven sweeps and the only stored bodies are three StockTwits digests, none of which mentions insider selling; aggregators report individual Form 4 dollar amounts but not the month-over-month density of Form 144 notices, and a 144 is per-seller so eleven notices means many distinct sellers rather than one plan. If it were priced I would expect at least one captured item on it and I would not expect Barclays to be raising its target to $38 from $31 on 2026-09-03 into the same window.
findings.independence: Nothing else in this corpus points the same way, and one thing cuts against it: the stock had already surrendered the entire move, from $34.53 on 08/28 to $30.17 by the 09-08 midday mark (quote.json), which is consistent with the supply having been at least partly absorbed. Because Braze's fiscal Q2 ended 31 July and the release is 8 September, discretionary sales in late August would sit inside a normal blackout, so these are most likely pre-set 10b5-1 dispositions - which is why the number is small. none.

searched_and_found_nothing: an explanation for the 2026-08-27 close of $34.09, up 10.7% on 3.15m shares against a 2.73m 20-day average, and the $34.53 follow-through on 08/28: no captured item, filing or StockTwits message in this corpus attributes that move to anything, and the whole gain was given back by the print
any 8-K after 2026-07-02 (items 5.03/5.07/9.01, annual-meeting and charter items) - no item 5.02 departure, no 1.01 agreement, no 7.01 in the nine weeks before the print

a company source for the buyout chatter that runs through the StockTwits digest (a '$50 buyout from CRM' post of 2026-08-17, WDAY speculation on 2026-08-13): no 13D, no 8-K, no filing supports it and I did not use it
a customer, ARR or net-revenue-retention datapoint from a third party for the quarter ended 31 July - nothing in the capture speaks to the quarter's realised trading
any read on the $100m repurchase authorisation flagged in the 2026-05-27 10-Q risk factors: no 8-K or filing discloses how much was executed
an S-3, 424B or secondary in the run-in

whether the activism risk created by the loss of super-voting control (8-K items 3.03/5.03/8.01 accepted 2026-02-02, restated as a new 10-Q risk factor) has produced an actual holder: every ownership filing in the lookback is a 13G or 13G/A, i.e. passive, and there is no 13D at all
baseline_tension: It agrees with the tape, which is the problem: the 5-day run-in is already -10.96%, so the market may have priced the same supply I am pointing at, which is why the number is a tenth of the expected move and not a half.
corpus_limits: No news channel for this name; three StockTwits digests are the only stored bodies, and no filing body text is stored, so I have the form, date and acceptance time of every Form 144 but not the share counts or the sellers' names, and cannot separate 10b5-1 from discretionary sales. One StockTwits item (docs/f36aeb591e98331b66171b864c698550ee1581ac.txt, 2026-09-01T22:26:51Z) relays Bloomberg options data putting the implied move at ~14% and says Braze has exceeded its implied move in five of the last eight prints; I have used that only to scale magnitude, not direction, and it is second-hand. No tripwire-flagged document appeared in this capture. quote.json's 2026-09-08 bar is a partial at 15:08 UTC ($30.165) and predates this amc print.
